instr: Tower: move all the disks onto the marked target peg, one disk at a time, never putting a larger disk on a smaller one.
clue: Move the whole tower of disks to the peg marked “target”. Take the top disk by clicking its peg (or pressing 1, 2 or 3), then click the peg where it should go. Move one disk at a time, and never put a larger disk on top of a smaller one. Try to use as few moves as you can. Press Start when ready.
illegal: Not allowed: a larger disk cannot go on a smaller one.
